The '''M'Bardi system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Kalamith sector/Legends|Kalamith sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[M'Bardi]].<ref name="Means and Ends" />
